<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 560 564" width="560" height="564" role="img" aria-label="Stakeholder Viewpoint">
<style>
svg{--bg:#ffffff;--fg:#18202d;--muted:#586375;--edge:#3d495b;--band:#f3f5f8;
 --am-biz:#fff4b3;--am-app:#c4edf7;--am-tech:#ccedc4;--am-mot:#ddd9f7;--am-imp:#fadcdc;--am-com:#eae4d7;
 --am-str:#f5deaa;--am-oth:#e2e5ea;--am-fg:#1c2230;--am-stroke:#596071}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){svg{--bg:#151b24;--fg:#e5eaf1;--muted:#9ba6b7;--edge:#a9b3c2;--band:#1b222d;
 --am-biz:#4a4526;--am-app:#1e4550;--am-tech:#23442a;--am-mot:#38355b;--am-imp:#4c2e31;--am-com:#453e35;
 --am-str:#4d3f24;--am-oth:#33393f;--am-fg:#eef0f4;--am-stroke:#9aa3b2}}
text{font-family:-apple-system,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif}
.bg{fill:var(--bg)} .band{fill:var(--band)} .band-t{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;fill:var(--muted)}
.title{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;fill:var(--fg)} .sub{font-size:11px;fill:var(--muted)}
.am{stroke:var(--am-stroke);stroke-width:1.1} .am-t{font-size:12px;font-weight:500;fill:var(--am-fg)}
.am-biz{fill:var(--am-biz)} .am-app{fill:var(--am-app)} .am-tech{fill:var(--am-tech)} .am-mot{fill:var(--am-mot)}
.am-imp{fill:var(--am-imp)} .am-com{fill:var(--am-com)} .am-str{fill:var(--am-str)} .am-oth{fill:var(--am-oth)}
.ico{fill:none;stroke:var(--am-fg);stroke-width:1.1;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.ico-f{fill:var(--am-fg);stroke:none}
.e{fill:none;stroke:var(--edge);stroke-width:1.3} .e-d{stroke-dasharray:6 4} .e-dot{stroke-dasharray:2 3}
.e-acc{stroke-dasharray:1.5 3}
.mk-s{fill:none;stroke:var(--edge);stroke-width:1.4;stroke-linejoin:round} .mk-f{fill:var(--edge)}
.mk-h{fill:var(--bg);stroke:var(--edge);stroke-width:1.2}
.lg-t{font-size:11px;fill:var(--fg)} .lg-h{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;fill:var(--muted)}
</style>
<defs>
<marker id="m-open" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9.2" refY="5" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" orient="auto-start-reverse" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path class="mk-s" d="M1,1 L9,5 L1,9"/></marker>
<marker id="m-open-s" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9.2" refY="5" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" orient="auto-start-reverse" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path class="mk-s" d="M1,1 L9,5 L1,9"/></marker>
<marker id="m-fill" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9.5" refY="5" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" orient="auto-start-reverse" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path class="mk-f" d="M0,1 L10,5 L0,9 Z"/></marker>
<marker id="m-tri" viewBox="-1 -1 14 14" refX="12" refY="6" markerWidth="13" markerHeight="13" orient="auto" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path class="mk-h" d="M0,0 L12,6 L0,12 Z"/></marker>
<marker id="m-dot" viewBox="0 0 8 8" refX="4" refY="4" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" orient="auto" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><circle class="mk-f" cx="4" cy="4" r="3"/></marker>
<marker id="m-dia-f" viewBox="-1 -1 14 12" refX="0" refY="5" markerWidth="14" markerHeight="12" orient="auto" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path class="mk-f" d="M0,5 L6,1.5 L12,5 L6,8.5 Z"/></marker>
<marker id="m-dia-h" viewBox="-1 -1 14 12" refX="0" refY="5" markerWidth="14" markerHeight="12" orient="auto" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path class="mk-h" d="M0,5 L6,1.5 L12,5 L6,8.5 Z"/></marker>
</defs>
<rect class="bg" x="0" y="0" width="560" height="564"/>
<text x="20" y="34" class="title">Stakeholder Viewpoint</text>
<text x="20" y="52" class="sub">workbench · Stakeholder Viewpoint · 元素 6 · 关系 4 · 由 tools/aisep.py diagram 从模型生成</text>
<rect class="band" x="20" y="66" width="520" height="380" rx="8"/>
<text class="band-t" x="32" y="86">动机</text>
<path data-kind="relationship" data-iri="https://aisep.example/model/workbench/rel-drvCrossModelApprover-influences-goalApproverInModel" data-type="am4:Influence" data-source="https://aisep.example/model/workbench/drvCrossModelApprover" data-target="https://aisep.example/model/workbench/goalApproverInModel" d="M186,138 L186,184" class="e e-d" marker-end="url(#m-open)"><title>影响：批准人可能误选别的模型的干系人 → 批准人属于被批模型</title></path>
<path data-kind="relationship" data-iri="https://aisep.example/model/workbench/rel-drvReleaseNeverExercised-influences-goalIdentifiableRelease" data-type="am4:Influence" data-source="https://aisep.example/model/workbench/drvReleaseNeverExercised" data-target="https://aisep.example/model/workbench/goalIdentifiableRelease" d="M186,328 L186,374" class="e e-d" marker-end="url(#m-open)"><title>影响：发布关口从没走过一次 → 能指认经过批准的发布版本</title></path>
<path data-kind="relationship" data-iri="https://aisep.example/model/workbench/rel-outApproverInModel-realizes-goalApproverInModel" data-type="am4:Realization" data-source="https://aisep.example/model/workbench/outApproverInModel" data-target="https://aisep.example/model/workbench/goalApproverInModel" d="M382,138 L382,148 L242,148 L242,184" class="e e-dot" marker-end="url(#m-tri)"><title>实现：工作台做出的批准在被批模型内自洽 → 批准人属于被批模型</title></path>
<path data-kind="relationship" data-iri="https://aisep.example/model/workbench/rel-outReleaseTagged-realizes-goalIdentifiableRelease" data-type="am4:Realization" data-source="https://aisep.example/model/workbench/outReleaseTagged" data-target="https://aisep.example/model/workbench/goalIdentifiableRelease" d="M382,328 L382,338 L242,338 L242,374" class="e e-dot" marker-end="url(#m-tri)"><title>实现：每个批准的发布都有批准记录和 release 标签 → 能指认经过批准的发布版本</title></path>
<g data-kind="element" data-iri="https://aisep.example/model/workbench/drvCrossModelApprover" data-type="am4:Driver" data-box="102 84 168 54"><title>驱动因素：批准人可能误选别的模型的干系人
工作台关口页曾列出所有模型的干系人并默认选中第一个，aisep #68 的批准因此签成了采购模型的首席架构师；只看工作台模型时这条批准不算数（aisep #73）。</title>
<path d="M112,84 H260 L270,94 V128 L260,138 H112 L102,128 V94 Z" class="am am-mot"/>
<circle cx="257" cy="96" r="4.6" class="ico"/>
<path d="M8,0.4 V11.6 M2.4,6 H13.6 M4,2 L12,10 M12,2 L4,10" transform="translate(249,90)" class="ico"/>
<circle cx="257" cy="96" r="1.5" class="ico-f"/>
<text x="186" y="107" text-anchor="middle" class="am-t">批准人可能误选别的模</text>
<text x="186" y="123" text-anchor="middle" class="am-t">型的干系人</text>
</g>
<g data-kind="element" data-iri="https://aisep.example/model/workbench/drvReleaseNeverExercised" data-type="am4:Driver" data-box="102 274 168 54"><title>驱动因素：发布关口从没走过一次
发布关口的规则（短命批准分支、release 标签、批准专用 PR）已写进接口规范 §5.9 和合并校验，但仓库里没有一条发布批准记录，也没有一个 release 标签；工作台关口页也不提供发布关口。</title>
<path d="M112,274 H260 L270,284 V318 L260,328 H112 L102,318 V284 Z" class="am am-mot"/>
<circle cx="257" cy="286" r="4.6" class="ico"/>
<path d="M8,0.4 V11.6 M2.4,6 H13.6 M4,2 L12,10 M12,2 L4,10" transform="translate(249,280)" class="ico"/>
<circle cx="257" cy="286" r="1.5" class="ico-f"/>
<text x="186" y="305" text-anchor="middle" class="am-t">发布关口从没走过一次</text>
</g>
<g data-kind="element" data-iri="https://aisep.example/model/workbench/goalApproverInModel" data-type="am4:Goal" data-box="130 184 168 54"><title>目标：批准人属于被批模型</title>
<path d="M140,184 H288 L298,194 V228 L288,238 H140 L130,228 V194 Z" class="am am-mot"/>
<circle cx="285" cy="196" r="5.4" class="ico"/>
<circle cx="285" cy="196" r="3.2" class="ico"/>
<circle cx="285" cy="196" r="1.1" class="ico-f"/>
<text x="214" y="215" text-anchor="middle" class="am-t">批准人属于被批模型</text>
</g>
<g data-kind="element" data-iri="https://aisep.example/model/workbench/goalIdentifiableRelease" data-type="am4:Goal" data-box="130 374 168 54"><title>目标：能指认经过批准的发布版本</title>
<path d="M140,374 H288 L298,384 V418 L288,428 H140 L130,418 V384 Z" class="am am-mot"/>
<circle cx="285" cy="386" r="5.4" class="ico"/>
<circle cx="285" cy="386" r="3.2" class="ico"/>
<circle cx="285" cy="386" r="1.1" class="ico-f"/>
<text x="214" y="397" text-anchor="middle" class="am-t">能指认经过批准的发布</text>
<text x="214" y="413" text-anchor="middle" class="am-t">版本</text>
</g>
<g data-kind="element" data-iri="https://aisep.example/model/workbench/outApproverInModel" data-type="am4:Outcome" data-box="298 84 168 54"><title>成果：工作台做出的批准在被批模型内自洽
之后在工作台关口页做出的批准记录，批准人都属于被批模型；只对被批模型跑 gate，不因批准人报错。</title>
<path d="M308,84 H456 L466,94 V128 L456,138 H308 L298,128 V94 Z" class="am am-mot"/>
<circle cx="452" cy="97" r="4.6" class="ico"/>
<circle cx="452" cy="97" r="2.4" class="ico"/>
<path d="M8,6 L14.5,0.5 M11.8,0.5 H14.5 V3.2" transform="translate(445,90)" class="ico"/>
<text x="382" y="107" text-anchor="middle" class="am-t">工作台做出的批准在被</text>
<text x="382" y="123" text-anchor="middle" class="am-t">批模型内自洽</text>
</g>
<g data-kind="element" data-iri="https://aisep.example/model/workbench/outReleaseTagged" data-type="am4:Outcome" data-box="298 258 168 70"><title>成果：每个批准的发布都有批准记录和 release 标签
批准的发布在主线上有一条发布关口批准记录，被发布的提交有一个指向它的 release 标签；驳回的发布只有记录，没有标签。</title>
<path d="M308,258 H456 L466,268 V318 L456,328 H308 L298,318 V268 Z" class="am am-mot"/>
<circle cx="452" cy="271" r="4.6" class="ico"/>
<circle cx="452" cy="271" r="2.4" class="ico"/>
<path d="M8,6 L14.5,0.5 M11.8,0.5 H14.5 V3.2" transform="translate(445,264)" class="ico"/>
<text x="382" y="281" text-anchor="middle" class="am-t">每个批准的发布都有批</text>
<text x="382" y="297" text-anchor="middle" class="am-t">准记录和 release 标</text>
<text x="382" y="313" text-anchor="middle" class="am-t">签</text>
</g>

<circle cx="95" cy="501" r="1.5" class="ico-f"/>
<text class="lg-t" x="116" y="505">驱动因素</text>

<circle cx="245" cy="501" r="5.4" class="ico"/>
<circle cx="245" cy="501" r="3.2" class="ico"/>
<circle cx="245" cy="501" r="1.1" class="ico-f"/>
<text class="lg-t" x="266" y="505">目标</text>
<path d="M390,492 H400 L410,502 V500 L400,510 H390 L380,500 V502 Z" class="am am-mot"/>
<circle cx="394" cy="502" r="4.6" class="ico"/>
<circle cx="394" cy="502" r="2.4" class="ico"/>
<path d="M8,6 L14.5,0.5 M11.8,0.5 H14.5 V3.2" transform="translate(387,495)" class="ico"/>
<text class="lg-t" x="416" y="505">成果</text>
<path d="M82,527 L112,527" class="e e-d" marker-end="url(#m-open)"/>
<text class="lg-t" x="120" y="531">影响</text>
<path d="M232,527 L262,527" class="e e-dot" marker-end="url(#m-tri)"/>
<text class="lg-t" x="270" y="531">实现</text>
</svg>
title: Stakeholder Viewpoint
